test_apply_updates: test the update.apply_updates function to add gradients to parameters and return new params
test_apply_updates_mixed_precision: test apply_updates with mixed precision bfloat16 params and float32 gradients preserving dtype
test_incremental_update: test the update.incremental_update function to interpolate between two parameter trees with a step size
test_periodic_update: test the update.periodic_update function to conditionally swap params based on an update period counter
test_none_argument: test that apply_updates and incremental_update handle None arguments without error
